shared_elements: wing rendered as rows of long parallel feathers
hatched or striated infill for feather and hair textures
figure occupying full height of a rectangular field
justification: Both surfaces show low-relief figures with a human head in strict profile combined with a large wing rendered as tiers of long parallel striated feathers, a fairly specific convention shared between them. However, A is a fragment preserving little more than a head, an arm and one feathered mass with no legible action, whereas B shows a complete two-panel narrative confrontation between a rearing composite bird-lion demon with talons and an armed, helmeted, winged warrior grasping weapons, so the relationships and the composition cannot be matched.
